title: Para swimmer Ernie Gawilan delivers PH's first gold in Asian Para Games

blocks.text: Veteran para swimmer Ernie Gawilan produced the Philippines' first gold medal in the 5th Asian Para Games on Monday, topping the men's 400-meter freestyle S7 podium at the Rainbow Pool of the Nagoya City General Gymnasium.
